scope: Actual current production objects/libraries, /O2 /GL /LTCG. Only main and candidate Reanimator.cpp objects replaced; no GPU/window/gameplay initialization. Forward looping animations only. All variants call the same production RootMotion and GetFrameTime consumers.

variants.current: Production cached keyframe index and current-keyframe birth anchor; actual Advance/ConsumeTimeAt path.
variants.divide_update_cached_queries: Cycle-local epoch; divide at every update, cache the derived frame for query reuse.
variants.divide_every_query: Cycle-local epoch; update only wraps completed cycles, leaves mCurrentFrame unused in measured forward path; derive frame using division in each query. ABI field still exists, so this does not measure memory savings.

hardware: Windows x64, process affinity LP14; frequency lock not set or verified. Forward/reverse executable order, 5 rounds per order, 1 million updates per round; 10 samples per cell.
fixtures: Authored normal zombie and football ground/walk tracks, positive rates 12/18/30/60. Same initial state and timestamps; loop/frame/root/frame-fraction checks against independent frozen arithmetic before timing.
validation: All 1440 timing rows agree on checksums across variants/orders. Separate exact validation passed for integer phase, loop count, per-update cycle crossings and previous event phase: 20000 updates x12 step/definition combinations x3 variants (720000 validation updates). Root/fraction/zombie output tolerance checks also pass identically.
limits: Not complete game-frame timing. No animated track transform walk, rendering, reverse playback, rate changes, seek, nonloop endpoints or save conversion tested; candidate patches are experiments only, not applied to production.
